# Gumroad

Gumroad simplifies selling digital goods, physical products, and memberships by offering a streamlined checkout, marketing tools, and direct payout options

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gumroad/.

## Actions

- **Get Resource Subscriptions**: Show all active subscriptions of the user for the input resource.
- **Get Sales**: Retrieve all successful sales by the authenticated user.
- **Get User**: Retrieve the authenticated user's data.
- **Subscribe to Resource**: Subscribe to a resource.
- **Unsubscribe From Resource**: Unsubscribe from a resource.
